end.summary:
Discussed earthworms and their tunnels in soil.
Pihu connected hard soil with water staying on top.
They identified that worm tunnels can let water enter the soil.
The idea that worms harm soil was not fully corrected; teach-back was not passed.
Session ended when Pihu asked to stop.
end.parentNote: Asha practised how earthworm tunnels help water move into the soil, using Pihu’s observations about hard soil. Pihu explained the tunnel-and-water connection, but still said worms are dirty and harmful; this was not fully corrected by the end. At home, look at a picture or short book about earthworms and ask, “How do their tunnels help soil?”
